description: Search results lead to arrests and court proceedings involving Three Years Jotna and Yankuba Darboe, but do not establish whether a public gathering occurred in February, who attended, whether at least 50 people were present, or what collective demand was made. The one opened account describes an individual court case and alleged speech, not a crowd.
required_followup: Review contemporaneous February reporting or court-day records for an explicitly reported public crowd, date, size, participants, and demand; preserve separate arrest/court episodes if no assembly is documented.

description: The Standard search headline says civil society organizations received a permit to hold a demonstration on Saturday, but neither the article date nor the demonstration date, turnout, demands, or execution is known. One fresh-gated exact-URL open returned Cache miss without an HTTP response or article body.
required_followup: If the exact public page becomes available through ordinary access, verify its publication date and the stated event date, whether it occurred, participant scale, and demand before considering a February candidate.

description: Search-only February headlines mention health-worker exclusion from a pay rise, GRA working conditions and staff meeting, and cost-of-rice concerns. They do not show a public action, participant count, or a demand directed to the Gambian government. The opened nurses article concerns a September 2021 strike, outside this unit.
required_followup: Check contemporary February union, workplace, and local-news reports for actual action, whether a meeting was public, the start date, attendance, and whether demands targeted government policy.

description: Search results refer to a reported temporary permit suspension and a UDP decision to postpone activities. No opened evidence identifies a specific February event, submitted permit, denial, or canceled gathering; these references cannot establish either a protest or its absence.
required_followup: Verify date, legal or administrative scope, and whether any named group planned a specific gathering or received a denial; do not treat context or postponement as an executed event.

description: A search-only result describes an NDI/Peace Ambassadors policy forum, while a Banyaka alkalorship result refers to village elders and resolution meetings whose last date is indexed as November. Public format, date, participant scale, state-directed demand, and any February assembly remain unverified.
required_followup: Verify the event date, public versus invited format, attendance, organizers, and exact demand; establish whether any village meeting began in February or belongs to an earlier episode.

description: Searches targeted Banjul, Serrekunda, Brikama, and Gunjur and several worker, health, education, agriculture, fishing, price, court, and opposition leads. Open-web coverage was not systematic across all localities or radio, print, and archive collections. Search strings included English and French, not Mandinka, Wolof, or Pulaar.
required_followup: Where available, check regional/local archives and radio or print records, and repeat discovery in Mandinka, Wolof, and Pulaar with competent language support; record source and locality coverage.

description: The official manual/baseline is pending. Protocol criteria were applied provisionally. Only two article bodies were opened, both from The Point; no independently corroborating body report was reviewed for the February leads.
required_followup: Coordinator should reconcile this dossier with the official baseline/manual when available and assess source independence and the original cutoff before any integration.
